# Hosted Publications fixed vectors

[Specification](../README.md) · [Acceptance tests](../acceptanceTests/README.md)

These vectors fix the signing, manifest and layered-encryption bytes. They were
produced by the independent script [generate.py](./generate.py), which uses only a
general cryptography library plus its own HChaCha20 (checked against the
published XChaCha20 test vector). Hexadecimal is display only. All times are Unix
seconds. A conforming implementation must reproduce every byte below.

Fixed inputs: the publisher uses the Ed25519 seed
`9d61b19deffd5a60ba844af492ec2cc44449c5697b326919703bac031cae7f60`; the reader
X25519 private key is the 32 bytes `40 41 ... 5f`; the ephemeral X25519 private
key is `80 81 ... 9f`; the content key is `c0 c1 ... df`; the content nonce is
`e0 ... f7`; the key-wrap nonce is `a0 ... b7`. The audience entry is the
identity ID below, not derived from a key in these vectors.
